description: Max raw bytes of the frontend entry chunk (the JS file dist/index.html loads first). Measured 594372 bytes on 2026-10-12 (580 KiB, after the code split in PR #161; it was 1277527 bytes before); set 2% plus rounding above. Ratchet down with `bun scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs --ratchet` whenever the chunk shrinks. Raise only with a reason in the PR.
